guides.title: Hotkeys · Input

learning_outcomes: Read the binding and its scope

steps.title: Read the binding and its scope
steps.body: Open Input and find Push-to-Talk. Read the displayed binding and group heading before editing. Right Ctrl is the default, but your saved value may differ. Global shortcuts work while another application has focus; application shortcuts require NC to have focus. If Input is absent, enable the addon.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Understand the Push-to-Talk exercise
steps.body: A microphone exercise requires a ready STT backend, the intended input device and Push-to-Talk session mode. If those are already ready, hold the displayed binding, say one short phrase and release; a transcript is the check. Otherwise finish this page and choose the related setup guides without changing the binding.

steps.title: Test pause with real speech playing
steps.body: In Conversation controls read Pause or resume speech. While a normal spoken reply is playing, press its binding with NC focused: speech should pause, and pressing again resumes. With no active speech this action has nothing to pause. Avoid Regenerate response and Retry user input as idle key tests; they change the last turn.

steps.title: Confirm any changed binding once
steps.body: For each binding you edit, confirm the displayed value and test its intended action once. Test outside NC only when the group says Global shortcuts. Restore default hotkeys in Window controls resets all groups, so use it only when you want that wider reset.

steps.title: Try a feature-window shortcut with NC focused
steps.body: Read the Show Visual Reply or Show MuseTalk Preview description. These bring forward an existing window; they do not create an image or load an avatar. Choose a feature you already have, click Record, press unused keys, release, and check the display. Escape cancels recording.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover a shortcut that does nothing
steps.body: If the keys do nothing, check NC focus, key collisions, and that content exists for that feature. Content for that feature is created through its own controls elsewhere in the app. Companion Orb shortcuts live in the Orb addon. Note any old value before a reset, and keep a way back for bindings you changed.
